verdict.rationale: Firebase is a proprietary managed cloud platform with no open-source self-hosted core; evidence shows only a local emulator suite for testing (firebase-docs-9, firebase-docs-24), not a self-hostable production deployment, and community comments explicitly cite Firebase as a vendor-lock-in service with no self-host option (firebase-comm-7, firebase-comm-10). No evidence of a self-hostable core product.
